All meetings and programs are open to the public. The meeting starts at 6:00 pm in room 117. Programsare in the second floor Commissioners' courtroom of the Historic Courthouse at 101
East Central Ave, Belton, Texas. The commission holds meetings every month of the year except December.
Meetings in February, April, July, and September include a program.

"Trails, Tails, and Tradition: European Migration & Stagecoach History" Speaker: Pam Anderson ‐ Ms. Anderson is the Executive Director of
the Texas Brazos Trail Region, Texas Heritage Trails, LLC. She is a well‐known speaker in historical circles. Her program will focus on exploring
historic inns, European migration, and the lively festivals that celebrate our shared past.

"Historic Homes of Temple, TX." Speaker: Dan Elder ‐ Mr. Elder will share pictures and the history of some of the beautiful homes in the
historic district of Temple, Texas.
Celebrating Comanche Gap Battlefield. Members will help the public learn about this historic local battle.

" The Poor Farms and Poor Home of Bell County, Texas" Speaker: Keith George. Mr. George's program talks about several Poor Farms and a
Poor Home during a period between 1886‐1969, as well as the Paupers' Cemetery at Pepper Creek, Temple, Texas.
